title: Khadija the Unbent
_note: A1.5. Lines keep MAIN_QUEST.md IDs where they have one, for voicing. Options show short text; spoken is the fuller line he says. starts: the first whose condition holds opens the conversation.

met.speaker: Khadija
met.text: [Dry, not unkind, from behind him.] You fight like a man who wants to die. It's very wasteful. I don't like waste.

name.speaker: Khadija
name.text: Khadija. They used to call me Unbent. I wasn't. I was just too stubborn to break. You're going to be dead in a week unless someone teaches you to stop being angry.

choices.text: [Dry] I'll learn faster by killing people.

breathing.speaker: Khadija
breathing.text: No. You need breathing. It's the same thing.

cove.speaker: Khadija
cove.text: The cove, south of the farms. A stone hut, a boat that doesn't float. Come when you can walk straight. And don't touch a weapon in front of me until I say so.

lesson1.speaker: Khadija
lesson1.text: First lesson. Breath. I'm going to hit you. You block as the blow lands. Not before, not after. As it lands. Three times, and we stop.

lesson2.speaker: Khadija
lesson2.text: Second lesson. Rage. Let it fill. All of it, past half. Then hold it. Don't spend it. Hold it, and see what it does to your hands.

debt.speaker: Khadija
debt.text: [She took the sword out of your hands while you were busy being angry.] You couldn't see me. You couldn't block. That's all rage is. A blindfold.

speech.speaker: Khadija
speech.text: You've been taught that rage is a fire. It isn't. It's a debt. Every time you spend it you borrow from tomorrow. You'll pay it back with interest, and the interest is people.

bank.speaker: Khadija
bank.text: No, you don't. Not yet. But you'll hold it a little longer now before it holds you. Go and see your herbalist. She's been waiting for you to come back with blood on you.

after.speaker: Khadija
after.text: Breathe. Then do whatever stupid thing you were going to do.
